heroHeadline: Israel Demolishes Ali al-Taher Tunnels; Aoun Pauses Talks as Port Blast Charges Sought Against Predecessor
heroSubtitle: Israel detonated ~1,100 tons of explosives on Sep 10 to destroy a two-decade-old Hezbollah tunnel network beneath the Ali al-Taher ridge, a blast Netanyahu called a 'massive victory' and paired with a warning of 'heavier blows' if Hezbollah attacks again. Nightly strikes, artillery and house demolitions continued in al-Mansouri, Kfartebnit and other southern towns through Sep 17, with Israeli drones also spotted over Beirut. President Aoun visited Nabatieh on Sep 12, ruling out new talks with Israel 'at the moment' as the Rome round was postponed to October in favor of a lower-level Washington ambassadors' meeting on Sep 16. Domestically, a prosecutor asked on Sep 15 that former president Michel Aoun be charged over the 2020 Beirut port blast, and Hezbollah MPs clashed with rivals in parliament on Sep 16 over the party's arms.
